LESSON: BELIEF IN ANGELS ATID,

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.2: Belief in Angels Atid,

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Belief in Angels Atid,. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What are the duties of angels?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the duties of the selected angels as a pillar of Iman
2. appreciate angels as Allah’s creation as a Pillar of Iman

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: BELIEF IN ANGELS ATID,
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 4
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Belief in Angels Atid, helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: BELIEF IN ANGELS ATID,
Study Belief in Angels Atid, like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Explain the duties of the selected angels as a pillar of Iman

What this means
In this part you learn to explain the duties of the selected angels as a pillar of Iman. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain the duties of the selected angels as a pillar of Iman.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Belief in Angels Atid,” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain the duties of the selected angels as a pillar of Iman. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Appreciate angels as Allah’s creation as a Pillar of Iman

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate angels as Allah’s creation as a Pillar of Iman. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate angels as Allah’s creation as a Pillar of Iman.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Belief in Angels Atid, in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate angels as Allah’s creation as a Pillar of Iman. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Belief in Angels Atid, is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Belief in Angels Atid,” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain the duties of the selected angels as a pillar of Iman)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Belief in Angels Atid, in your own words. (skill: appreciate angels as Allah’s creation as a Pillar of Iman)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Belief in Angels Atid, to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: explain the duties of the selected angels as a pillar of Iman.
3. Practise this skill: appreciate angels as Allah’s creation as a Pillar of Iman.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Belief in Angels Atid, from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Belief in Angels Atid,: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 4 learner study Belief in Angels Atid,?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the duties of angels?
2. Why did Allah (S.W.T.) create angels?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Belief in Angels Atid, means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: explain the duties of the selected angels as a pillar of Iman.
5. Be able to: appreciate angels as Allah’s creation as a Pillar of Iman.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
